newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices rise mildly on fresh demand.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices rise mildly on fresh demand.

text.p: Sugar prices improved mildly on Wednesday on fresh demand and buying from other centres, traders said.
They said there had been a revival in demand for sugar from consuming centres in neighbouring states.
In ready delivery, S-30 gained 5.0/10 rupees to 1,350/1,370 rupees per quintal but M-30 was steady at 1,385/1,460 rupees per quintal.
Sugar mill delivery was offered 5.0/10 rupees higher at 1,285/1,295 rupees per quintal.
"Market sentiment is firm in anticipation of higher demand in the coming days," said a trader.
